notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Sources give the tower's name, county, coordinates, the FFLA 'Tower Gone' status, and a Barnes location from a map gazetteer (Mapcarta). The gazetteer match is on name and county only; its pin was not compared with the FFLA coordinates. The Central US Lookouts page text we could read has only the title and county. No build date, design, staffing, fires or site description found. Two WebSearch queries and page reads found nothing more. An anyplaceamerica topo page for the same name returned 403. Story is about 80 words, below the 120-word guide for thin sources, because nothing else is sourced. Verification 2026-10-10: removed the unsourced region phrase 'northwestern Wisconsin' from the story; no cited source gives a regional location.
